name: Austarnet
summary: AUSTAR's regional dialup ISP/portal (regional access points); website folded over to the AustarMetro presence by Jan 2004, but the regional customer base persisted (ACCC records ~9,328 customers Dec 2010); fate after Austar's 2012 Foxtel merger undocumented (AUSTAR UNITED BROADBAND PTY LTD, ACN 089 048 439).

events.details: austarnet.com.au live by 2000; earliest Wayback capture 19 Jun 2000.

austarnet.com.au full portal content live Feb 2003, serving a 302 redirect by Jan 2004 (web presence folded over). The regional customer base evidently persisted: ACCC industry records still listed ~9,328 AUSTARnet customers in Dec 2010. Final fate undocumented (Austar merged with Foxtel in 2012).
